dedupe_keys.name: southeastern pennsylvania transportation authority septa gtfs schedule and real time transit data

description: Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA): GTFS schedule and real-time transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA). Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for New Castle County, Delaware, United States, with real-time vehicle, trip or alert feeds. Coverage: New Castle County, Delaware, United States. The Mobility Database lists 2 GTFS schedule feeds and 6 GTFS Realtime feeds for this provider (New Castle County, Delaware, United States). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Bike Allowed, Contactless EMV Support, Fare Media, Fare Products, Fare Transfers, Feed Information, Headsigns, In-station Traversal Time. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence given by link only (https://www3.septa.org/developer/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
